speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of your symptoms better. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as chronic diarrhea or the passage of greasy, floating stools?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (specifically considering lymphoma with abdominal involvement or primary abdominal lymphoma given the supraclavicular nodes, systemic B-symptoms, and weight loss).

I will not ask further questions to preserve the limit; the classic presentation of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with palpable supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain is highly suggestive of a malignancy until proven otherwise. Please undergo a CT of the abdomen and pelvis with contrast, and a biopsy of the most accessible lymph node immediately.
